newsitem.title: USA: Failure Group cuts outlook for Q4.
newsitem.headline: Failure Group cuts outlook for Q4.

text.p: The Failure Group, which reported lower third-quarter earnings on Tuesday, also said it had lowered its expectations for the fourth quarter.
The company -- an engineering consultancy that investigates equipment failures, said third-quarter net income fell to $0.06 a share from $0.09 in the same period last year.
The drop reflected a slowdown in litigation projects at its Phoenix test facility and declining usage of its computer and database services, it said.
"With the slowdown in Phoenix expected to continue for the duration of 1996, we have reduced our outlook for the fourth quarter," the company said.
Officials were not immediately available to elaborate on its fourth-quarter forecast.
